faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our treatments and the process at Marsa Project.

items.q: What is Marsa Project and what services does it offer?
items.a: Marsa Project is a dental clinic in Toluca specialized in oral rehabilitation, dental implants and aesthetic dentistry. We also offer whitening, porcelain veneers, smile design and clear aligners.
It is a solution used to replace the root of a missing tooth and later receive a dental restoration that helps recover function and aesthetics.

items.q: Can anyone get a dental implant?
items.a: Not necessarily. Suitability depends on each patient's clinical conditions and must be determined through a professional assessment.

items.q: Do I need an assessment before starting?
items.a: Yes. The first step is an assessment to understand the conditions of your case and define the corresponding treatment plan.

items.q: How much does a dental implant cost?
items.a: The cost depends on the characteristics of each case, the procedures required and the treatment plan. That is why we recommend starting with an assessment.
The time depends on the clinical conditions and on the treatment indicated for each patient. The assessment makes it possible to estimate the timeline for your case.

items.q: What does digital smile design include?
items.a: It includes a clinical and aesthetic evaluation, a digital simulation of the treatment proposal and a detailed plan before starting any procedure.

items.q: How long do treatment results last?
items.a: It depends on the treatment indicated, each patient's clinical conditions, home care and periodic check-ups. Your specialist will explain what to expect in your case.

items.q: Do you offer payment plans or financing?
items.a: Yes — we offer flexible payment plans and financing options adapted to your budget so you can access the treatment you need.

Marsa Project is located at Paseo Cristóbal Colón 128-MZ 027, Residencial Colón y Colonia Ciprés, 50120 Toluca de Lerdo, State of Mexico. We are open Monday to Friday from 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. and Saturdays from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

items.q: How can I book an assessment?
items.a: You can request information and book your assessment via WhatsApp, through the contact form or by calling 722 535 6109.
